article_title: The simple skincare routine for teens that actually works - and five expert tips

tasks.prompt: What is the experts' central advice for teenage skincare?
options: Use a simple routine and seek medical help for persistent severe acne
Copy the longest routine recommended by an influencer
Remove all visible pores with strong acids
Treat every blemish as an abnormal condition
tasks.correct_answer: Use a simple routine and seek medical help for persistent severe acne
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המומחים ממליצים על שגרה בסיסית ועדינה, ועל פנייה לרופא כאשר האקנה חמור או מתמשך.

tasks.prompt: Which three products make up the basic routine recommended in the article?
options: An exfoliating acid, toner and face mask
A gentle cleanser, fragrance-free moisturiser and SPF 30-or-higher sunscreen
Retinoids, perfume and a hydrocolloid patch
Shaving foam, serum and protein shake
tasks.correct_answer: A gentle cleanser, fragrance-free moisturiser and SPF 30-or-higher sunscreen
tasks.explanation_hebrew: שלושת היסודות הם ניקוי עדין, קרם לחות ללא בושם ומסנן קרינה רחב טווח בדרגת SPF 30 לפחות.

tasks.prompt: What does “skin barrier compromise” mean in the warning about too many active products?
options: A product cannot enter a shop
Teenagers stop following influencers
The skin's protective function becomes damaged or weakened
Pores become completely invisible
tasks.correct_answer: The skin's protective function becomes damaged or weakened
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי מתאר פגיעה או היחלשות בשכבת ההגנה של העור כתוצאה משימוש יתר בחומרים פעילים.

tasks.prompt: What does “flare-up” mean when the dermatologists discuss acne?
options: A permanent cure for acne
A change in facial hair colour
A laboratory test for hormones
A period when symptoms become worse
tasks.correct_answer: A period when symptoms become worse
tasks.explanation_hebrew: flare-up הוא החמרה זמנית או התפרצות של תסמינים.

tasks.prompt: Why can picking or popping spots cause harm?
options: It may push material deeper, increase inflammation and cause scarring or discolouration
It always removes the skin barrier completely
It prevents any future oil production
It lowers testosterone immediately
tasks.correct_answer: It may push material deeper, increase inflammation and cause scarring or discolouration
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לחיצה על פצעונים עלולה להעמיק את התוכן, להגביר דלקת ולהוביל לצלקות או שינויי צבע.

tasks.prompt: What does “acne-prone skin” mean in the discussion of salicylic acid?
options: Skin that never produces oil
Skin that tends to develop acne
Skin that requires a multi-step routine
Skin that cannot use moisturiser
tasks.correct_answer: Skin that tends to develop acne
tasks.explanation_hebrew: prone פירושו בעל נטייה; כאן מדובר בעור שנוטה לפתח אקנה.

tasks.prompt: Give two reasons the article says an overly complicated routine can make teenage skin worse.
expected_points: Strong acids or frequent exfoliation can irritate young skin
The developing skin barrier can be damaged
Overuse of hydroxy acids or retinoids is linked to perioral dermatitis
Numerous serums, toners, masks and actives can create additional skin problems
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שני מנגנונים או נזקים מן הכתבה, ולא לטעון שכל חומר פעיל מזיק בכל שימוש.

tasks.prompt: Why do the experts challenge the social-media idea of “glass skin”?
expected_points: Filtered images create an unrealistic standard
Visible pores, blemishes, redness and pigmentation can be normal
Different people have different versions of normal skin
Chasing perfection may encourage excessive product use and irritation
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשר בין דימויים מסוננים, שונות טבעית בעור והסיכון לשגרות מוגזמות; אין לטעון שאין טיפול יעיל באקנה.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the article's explanation of teenage acne and its practical skincare advice.
expected_points: Puberty hormones can increase oil production, blocked follicles and inflammation
Acne is common, normal and treatable
A gentle cleanser, fragrance-free moisturiser and sunscreen form the basic routine
Excessive actives, picking spots, poor sleep and some diets may worsen problems
Persistent painful, cystic or scarring acne needs professional medical advice
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב סיכום באנגלית שמבדיל בין שינויים נפוצים בגיל ההתבגרות לבין סימנים המצדיקים פנייה לרופא.

tasks.prompt: Explain how the article balances acceptance of normal teenage skin with advice to treat genuine problems.
expected_points: Pores, blackheads, blemishes, redness and pigmentation may be normal
More than 80% of teenagers experience acne
Simple care can protect the developing skin barrier
Salicylic acid may help oily or acne-prone skin but excessive use can irritate
Severe, painful, cystic or scarring acne may require prescription treatment
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב פסקה באנגלית המציגה קבלה של שונות טבעית לצד טיפול מידתי, ולהביא לפחות שלוש ראיות מן הכתבה.
